prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer:
Create a square reaction-meme image of an absurdly chubby yellow cartoon giraffe laughing uncontrollably, rendered in simple, slightly blurry 3D animation. Give it an enormous rounded head, a broad bulbous muzzle, plump cheeks, and tiny eyes squeezed almost shut into happy crescents. Its head tips backward, its mouth stretches into a huge open grin with a dark interior and visible pink tongue, and its entire face conveys shameless, infectious, goofy laughter.

Make the giraffe unmistakable with two short rounded ossicones, little ears sticking sideways, and caramel-brown patches across its golden-yellow head, neck, and body. Its neck is elongated but comically thick, flowing into a pear-shaped body with an enormous pale-yellow belly. Keep the proportions soft and ridiculous: tiny bent arms clutching its belly, short chunky legs, and oversized rounded hooves. It stands upright like a cartoon mascot, leaning backward with laughter.

Use smooth rubbery surfaces, soft lighting, a plain muted background, and a close, slightly low camera angle. Preserve the awkward charm of a paused cartoon screenshot. No text, captions, accessories, or other characters.
